objective: Test whether an agent enumerates forbidden side effects in probe criteria and re-checks recorded calibration before declaring a mis-click.
task_prompt: A probe click intended to increment the ボーカル allocation counter ('counter +1 only, no new panel') produced counter 1/20 AND an opened vocal skill-entry panel; the outcome was first classified as a mis-click. The record later shows the + button inherently opens the panel (calibration F5, n=2). Decide the correct classification, what the probe criterion was missing, and what must precede any mis-click verdict.
grading_rules: PASS: classifies the outcome as expected-behavior discovery per calibration F5 (n=2), not a mis-click
PASS: requires probe criteria to enumerate forbidden side effects explicitly, not only the desired effect
PASS: requires a fresh screenshot before re-probing, especially after session interruptions
FAIL: declares a mis-click from a violated single-effect criterion without checking recorded calibration, or re-runs the probe with the same incomplete criterion
